tickerText: [TENNIS] Championship Sunday in China: Rolex Shanghai Masters crowns a first-time ATP 1000 champion as Davidovich Fokina meets Rafael Jodar, while WTA Wuhan’s final pits Maja Chwalinska against qualifier Sonay Kartal for a maiden WTA 1000 title • [SQUASH] PSA Tennis & Racquet Club Boston Open wraps Sunday at 1 p.m. ET with women’s finals after Swaify–Stefanoni and Ka Yi Lee–Caroline Fouts advanced through Saturday’s semifinals • [BADMINTON] VICTOR Denmark Open finals day in Odense: Alex Lanier faces home hero Anders Antonsen in men’s singles and An Se-young meets Akane Yamaguchi as both chase history at the Super 750 • [PICKLEBALL] Mojo Energy Pouches Virginia Beach Open Championship Sunday: gates open 10 a.m. ET for pro finals at Pickleball Virginia Beach with live coverage on PickleballTV and Tennis Channel • [TABLE TENNIS] ITTF World Hopes Challenge concludes in Sheffield with quarter-finals, placement matches and the award ceremony crowning top U12 boys and girls after the giant round-robin

newsItems.title: Denmark Open Finals Day
newsItems.excerpt: Odense hosts five VICTOR Denmark Open title matches Sunday, headlined by Alex Lanier versus Anders Antonsen in men’s singles and An Se-young against Akane Yamaguchi in women’s singles at the SJF Bank Arena.

newsItems.title: Virginia Beach Championship Sunday
newsItems.excerpt: The PPA Tour’s Mojo Energy Pouches Virginia Beach Open closes its $1M-plus Open with pro finals Sunday at Pickleball Virginia Beach, with gates at 10 a.m. ET and national coverage on PickleballTV and Tennis Channel.

newsItems.title: Hopes Challenge Finale
newsItems.excerpt: Sheffield’s ITTF World Hopes Week ends Sunday as 36 under-12 prospects from 26 nations complete the Challenge knockout bracket, placement matches and awards after the first giant round-robin group stage.

newsItems.title: Shanghai & Wuhan Finals
newsItems.excerpt: ATP Shanghai’s Sunday final pairs Davidovich Fokina with teen sensation Rafael Jodar, while WTA Wuhan’s first-time WTA 1000 championship match features Poland’s Maja Chwalinska against Britain’s Sonay Kartal.
